text_block_list.text: One day, as training camp continued—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that takes care of the whole 
training menu.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I wonder if I pushed a bit too hard?
choice_data_list: Should we do some extra training?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No, it's a bit early, but let's call it a 
day here.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I promised my juniors that I'd 
throw a party with them tonight.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
See, training camp is harder than usual, 
so it's meant to be a treat for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"And since I have a car, I'm on shopping 
duty. So I've got to go buy supplies!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Not "have a good trip"— you're coming with 
me, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Not "have a good trip"— you're coming with 
me, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's enjoy a shopping drive while 
watching the sun set!
(VROOM VRRRROOOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Blasting through surrounded by nature 
feels the absolute best! The sunset really 
stings my eyes, though~!"

And so, on the way back from grocery 
shopping with Maruzensky—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No waaay!! Why isn't it moving?! What's 
wrong, Tacchan?!

Suddenly, Maruzensky's car ground to a 
halt.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Maybe running on an unfamiliar, dirty 
track threw me off my game...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a dilemma~ I'm worried about 
Tacchan, but the party with everyone...
choice_data_list: Let's try our best to fix it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? You want me to go, and leave you 
here all by yourself, Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? You want me to go, and leave you 
here all by yourself, Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I mean, sure, I could make a quick run and 
deliver the luggage, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ……Geez, bringing that up here is unfair.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, I understand. First, I'll go 
deliver what we bought!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll be right back as soon as I deliver 
this, so take good care of Tac-chan until 
then!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's just the right amount of exercise, so 
let's go~!

And so, loaded up with all her shopping 
bags, Maruzensky dashed away.

Afterward, the car was successfully 
repaired, and the party concluded as a 
huge success.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Even if you tell me to try fixing it, I 
don't know the first thing about 
maintenance...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know! Maybe it'll start working 
if we hit it!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You know what you do when the TV 
reception's bad, right? You give it a 
chop-chop at a 45-degree angle!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no way!? Isn't that just common 
knowledge!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway, nothing ventured, nothing 
gained!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, wake up, Tacchan! This is no time 
to be sleeping!

Maruzensky slammed her hands on the 
steering wheel. And then—
(Vro... Vrooooom)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yay! Tac-chan woke up!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, giving it a good whack really does 
the trick~. Now then, let's head back to 
everyone!

And so, we boarded the car once it started 
moving and made it back safely to the 
training camp lodge.

Afterward, she continued to advocate her 
'whacking fixes everything' theory even at 
the party, only to be lectured that it 
would break things.
